## Highlights

- Fixed the Windows x64 updater feed URL so automatic and manual checks use the repository's canonical `eaforlife/media-converter` slug.
- Replaced the long Squirrel/.NET 404 stack trace with a short, actionable update message.
- Limited background Squirrel updates to Windows x64, the architecture safely served by the current release manifest.
- Windows ARM64, unsigned macOS, and Linux builds now give clear platform-specific manual update guidance instead of starting an unsupported update check.
- Updated application metadata, publishing configuration, documentation, and changelog links to the canonical repository URL.

## One-time upgrade notice

- Versions 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 contain the old feed URL and cannot discover this correction automatically. Install v0.3.2 manually from this release once; later Windows x64 releases can then be discovered in the app.

## Validation

- Confirmed the old update feed returns 404 and the corrected Windows x64 feed returns a valid Squirrel `RELEASES` manifest.
- Lint, TypeScript, compatibility typecheck, and eight regression tests.
- Windows x64 production package and installer build.
